query: What signals suggest a support ticket will take longer to resolve?

per_column.name: ticket_category
per_column.rationale: Type of issue (bug, outage, feature_request) is knowable at intake and plausibly correlates with resolution time. Legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: product_area
per_column.rationale: Which product component the ticket concerns is available at intake and different areas plausibly have different resolution complexity.

per_column.name: is_active_outage
per_column.rationale: Whether an active outage is in progress is knowable at ticket creation and plausibly drives resolution duration.

per_column.name: business_impact_type
per_column.rationale: Nature of business impact is derivable from the ticket at intake and correlates with prioritization/effort. Legitimate signal.

per_column.name: urgency_driver
per_column.rationale: Stated urgency driver is available upfront and plausibly relates to how quickly/complexly a ticket is handled.

per_column.name: root_cause_mechanism
per_column.rationale: The root cause mechanism is typically only determined DURING or AFTER investigation/resolution. Knowing the true root cause is downstream of the diagnostic effort that consumes resolution time, so it leaks the outcome.

per_column.name: is_regression
per_column.rationale: Whether the issue was a regression is a diagnostic conclusion usually reached during resolution, not reliably knowable at intake. Post-hoc determination leaks resolution effort.

per_column.name: affected_user_scope
per_column.rationale: Scope of affected users can be characterized from the ticket at intake and plausibly predicts effort/priority. Legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: involves_third_party_integration
per_column.rationale: Whether a third-party integration is involved is inferable at intake and third-party dependencies plausibly lengthen resolution. Legitimate.

per_column.name: involves_data_integrity_risk
per_column.rationale: Data integrity risk is characterizable from the reported symptoms at intake and plausibly carries predictive signal on duration.

per_column.name: has_security_or_compliance_dimension
per_column.rationale: Security/compliance dimension is identifiable from the ticket at intake and plausibly affects handling time. Legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: workaround_available
per_column.rationale: Whether a workaround was mentioned by the customer is present in the intake description and plausibly relates to urgency/effort. Legitimate.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are intake-time attributes derived from the issue description that lie outside resolution_minutes and plausibly carry predictive signal (category, product area, outage status, impact, urgency, scope, integration/security/data-integrity flags, workaround). Two columns—root_cause_mechanism and is_regression—represent diagnostic conclusions typically established only during or after the resolution process and thus risk leaking the outcome. As a set the features provide substantial, genuine predictive leverage beyond the original columns, discounted for the leakage-prone diagnostic fields.
